title: The Return and the Chronicles Perspective
subtitle: Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther, Chronicles, Joel, Obadiah, Haggai, Zechariah, Malachi
theme: A partial return. God keeps his promises but the full restoration awaits.
memoryText: Behold, your king is coming to you; righteous and having salvation is he, humble and mounted on a donkey.
reviewQuestions: Why does the post-exilic community’s joy at the Temple’s rebuilding turn to weeping?
What does Chronicles add to our understanding of the monarchy?
How does Malachi set up the 400 years of silence before Christ?
What do the visions in Zechariah reveal about the coming Messiah?
psalmsNote: Songs of return (85, 107, 126), the closing praise psalms (145 to 150), the reign psalms (96 to 99), and temple psalms (115, 132, 135, 136).
